name: Md Raffiul Islam
summary: I build scalable Angular interfaces and Spring Boot services for social protection, education, training, and institutional management systems—with security, maintainability, and real operational workflows at the center.
about: I'm a Computer Science & Engineering graduate from the University of Dhaka and a Software Engineer at Karooth IT (BD) Limited. I contribute across Angular micro frontends, Spring Boot services, databases, messaging, security, and enterprise integrations.

deliveryStrengths.title: Backend services & security
